rationale: The assistant correctly identified dE as a door-not-closed/locked error, told the customer to check the seal area for trapped items, and once the customer reported the king-size duvet bulging and squashed in the seal it pinned the cause on the overfilled drum and had them confirm with a normal load. It reached the hidden truth in three turns with no part recommended and sensible, conditional escalation only if dE persisted with normal loads. Minor weaknesses: the opening said it could not confirm what dE meant (it is a standard LG door error) and did not directly ask what was loaded in the drum, and the interlock was raised a little early as 'leading suspect' before the load was known.
